MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many main tones does Mandarin have, not counting the neutral tone? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Four
   C. Three
   D. Two

2. What do we call the sound at the beginning of a Mandarin syllable, such as h in hǎo? (1 mark)
   A. A stroke
   B. An initial
   C. A tone
   D. A final

3. On which letter does the tone mark go in the syllable liù? (1 mark)
   A. u
   B. l
   C. i
   D. No letter

4. Which Chinese word means "daughter"? (1 mark)
   A. 是 shì
   B. 女儿 nǚ'ér
   C. 有 yǒu
   D. 哥哥 gēge

5. In the sentence 电视在桌子上, where is the television? (1 mark)
   A. Beside the door
   B. Under the table
   C. On the table
   D. In the kitchen

6. What does 冰箱 (bīngxiāng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Beside
   B. Sofa
   C. Left side
   D. Fridge

7. Which Kiswahili day is Monday? (1 mark)
   A. Jumamosi
   B. Jumatatu
   C. Jumapili
   D. Ijumaa

8. Which is a good step for reading a sentence at a good pace? (1 mark)
   A. Read as fast as you can at once
   B. Read slowly first, then join the words and speed up
   C. Read only the first word
   D. Read without looking

9. In the song 头、肩膀、膝盖、脚, which word is a joint in the leg? (1 mark)
   A. 膝盖
   B. 脚
   C. 肩膀
   D. 头

10. Which sentence describes the position of the window above the sofa? (1 mark)
   A. 窗户在沙发上面。
   B. 沙发在窗户上面。
   C. 沙发在门旁边。
   D. 浴室在花园旁边。

11. What does 早上好 zǎoshang hǎo mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good night
   B. Goodbye
   C. Thank you
   D. Good morning

12. What does 姐姐 (jiějie) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mother
   B. Older sister
   C. To have, there is
   D. Love

13. What should you say when giving feedback on someone's reading? (1 mark)
   A. One good thing and one thing to improve
   B. Something unkind
   C. Nothing
   D. Only what was bad

14. What does 吗 ma do at the end of a sentence? (1 mark)
   A. It ends a list
   B. It means mother
   C. It means and
   D. It makes a yes-or-no question

15. How many rooms are named in 我家有客厅、卧室和厨房? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Three
   C. Two
   D. Five

16. What does 厨房 (chúfáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Things
   B. On
   C. Television
   D. Kitchen

17. What does 星期六 (xīngqīliù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eight
   B. Three
   C. Saturday
   D. Church

18. What is vocal projection? (1 mark)
   A. Sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting
   B. Reading very fast
   C. Reading in a whisper
   D. Reading without tones

19. Which sentence is in the right order for "We cut the cake"? (1 mark)
   A. 切我们蛋糕。
   B. 我们切蛋糕。
   C. 蛋糕我们切。
   D. 蛋糕切我们。

20. Which word is pronounced xiāngjiāo? (1 mark)
   A. 香蕉
   B. 米饭
   C. 牛奶
   D. 蔬菜

21. What does 午饭 (wǔfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To eat
   B. Beef
   C. Lunch
   D. Grapes

22. What does 窗户 (chuānghu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Window
   B. Is at, is in
   C. Toilet
   D. Fridge

23. How many strokes does the character 大 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 3
   C. 2
   D. 5

24. Read the pinyin: diànshì zài kètīng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The television is in the living room.
   B. The bed is in the bedroom.
   C. The garden is on the right of the house.
   D. The door is on the left.

25. Read the pinyin: kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The window is above the sofa.
   B. The door is on the left.
   C. There is a television in the living room.
   D. The television is on the table.

26. Which Chinese word means "is at, is in"? (1 mark)
   A. 在 zài
   B. 床 chuáng
   C. 桌子 zhuōzi
   D. 房子 fángzi

27. What does 二 (èr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. One
   C. Two
   D. Eight

28. What is the apostrophe for in xīngqī'èr? (1 mark)
   A. To show a capital
   B. To show a question
   C. To separate the syllables qī and èr
   D. To show a tone

29. What does 饼干 (bǐnggān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Biscuits
   B. Lunch
   C. Cooked rice
   D. Grapes

30. Fill the blank: 我早饭____饼。 (For breakfast I eat bǐng.) (1 mark)
   A. 去
   B. 是
   C. 喝
   D. 吃

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Punctuate the sentences: 你好 (greeting), 我叫小明 (statement), 你呢 (question). Write the full sentences. (2 marks)

32. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We sing." (2 marks)

33. Write the question for "Who is this?" and answer it with "This is my father", with pinyin. (2 marks)

34. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The fridge is in the kitchen." (2 marks)

35. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天气 and 星期六. (2 marks)

36. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 八 and 玩. (2 marks)

37. Write the five weather words in pinyin. (3 marks)

38. Read and translate: 冰箱在厨房。 Then write the question that asks where the fridge is. (3 marks)

39. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛肉 and 女儿. (2 marks)

40. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Sunday, go to church." (3 marks)

41. Name the days of the week from Monday to Wednesday in Chinese with pinyin. (3 marks)

42. Read jiào, nǐ and hǎo and write each with its Chinese character and meaning. (3 marks)

43. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a television in the living room." (3 marks)

44. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nǐ ne? (2 marks)

45. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my younger brother." (2 marks)

46. Explain why tones are important in Mandarin. Give one example with meanings. (3 marks)

47. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister." (2 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 香蕉 and 饼. (2 marks)

49. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The door is on the left." (2 marks)

50. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The window is above the sofa." (3 marks)

51. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Four
   Mandarin has four main tones: high level, rising, dipping and falling.

2. B — An initial
   The consonant sound at the start of a syllable is the initial.

3. A — u
   With iu the mark goes on the second vowel, u.

4. B — 女儿 nǚ'ér
   女儿 (nǚ'ér) means daughter.

5. C — On the table
   上 means on.

6. D — Fridge
   冰箱 (bīngxiāng) means fridge.

7. B — Jumatatu
   Jumatatu is Monday. Jumamosi is Saturday and Jumapili is Sunday.

8. B — Read slowly first, then join the words and speed up
   Slow reading first, then a natural speed.

9. A — 膝盖
   膝盖 is the knee.

10. A — 窗户在沙发上面。
   上面 means above.

11. D — Good morning
   早上 is morning and 好 is good.

12. B — Older sister
   姐姐 (jiějie) means older sister.

13. A — One good thing and one thing to improve
   Kind feedback names a strength and one suggestion.

14. D — It makes a yes-or-no question
   电视在桌子上吗? asks whether the television is on the table.

15. B — Three
   The rooms are the living room, the bedroom and the kitchen.

16. D — Kitchen
   厨房 (chúfáng) means kitchen.

17. C — Saturday
   星期六 (xīngqīliù) means Saturday.

18. A — Sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting
   Good breathing and an open mouth help you project.

19. B — 我们切蛋糕。
   The order is who, action, thing.

20. A — 香蕉
   香蕉 is pronounced xiāngjiāo and means banana.

21. C — Lunch
   午饭 (wǔfàn) means lunch.

22. A — Window
   窗户 (chuānghu) means window.

23. B — 3
   大 has 横, 撇 and 捺.

24. A — The television is in the living room.
   diànshì zài kètīng. is 电视在客厅。, which means "The television is in the living room.".

25. C — There is a television in the living room.
   kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì. is 客厅里有电视。, which means "There is a television in the living room.".

26. A — 在 zài
   在 (zài) means is at, is in.

27. C — Two
   二 (èr) means two.

28. C — To separate the syllables qī and èr
   It marks where èr begins.

29. A — Biscuits
   饼干 (bǐnggān) means biscuits.

30. D — 吃
   饼 is food, so 吃.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你好! 我叫小明。 你呢?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the two correct marks, 2 marks for all three.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我们唱歌。 wǒmen chànggē.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi? 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: 冰箱在厨房。 bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: 天气: tiānqì, weather. 星期六: xīngqīliù, Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: 八: bā, eight. 玩: wán, to play.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: tàiyáng, yún, fēng, yǔ, xuě.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for all five.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: bīngxiāng zài chúfáng. The fridge is in the kitchen. Question: 冰箱在哪儿?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for translation, 1 mark for the question.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: 牛肉: niúròu, beef. 女儿: nǚ'ér, daughter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期天,去教堂。 xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期一 xīngqīyī, 星期二 xīngqī'èr, 星期三 xīngqīsān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each day.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: 叫 jiào (to be called), 你 nǐ (you), 好 hǎo (good).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: 客厅里有电视。 kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: And you?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 那是我弟弟。 nà shì wǒ dìdi.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: The tone changes the meaning of a word. For example mā means mother but mǎ means horse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying tone changes meaning, 2 marks for a correct pair with meanings.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 香蕉: xiāngjiāo, banana. 饼: bǐng, flat bread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.
